research_status: exploratory screening baseline; not approved for engineering ductility release
inputs: test temperature, source wt.% composition, cast/DS/SC route, casting gradient and recorded heat-treatment stages
boundaries: Elongation is a tensile ductility measurement under its recorded test condition; it is not a fracture-toughness or creep-ductility prediction.
Hardness is not a label in this source database and is intentionally absent from this service model.
